identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

values.summary: Implemented the restart-safe warm two-node AWS Polis and historically qualified it twice on the earlier 16-vCPU GPU shape; the current-quota g6.xlarge qualification and its 120-second GPU, 30-second Runtime, and 270-second controller gates remain pending.
actual_changes: Separated retained warm storage, disposable preparation, and disposable compute ownership under exact Terraform plans and single-use authorization.

Prepared immutable Runtime and GPU AMIs plus integrity-bound persistent EBS volumes once, with no launch-time build, package installation, Git access, model download, or mutable dependency resolution.
Kept Guardian and Runtime alive independently of qualification failures and kept Ollama private to the Runtime-to-GPU path.
Retained the two earlier larger-shape live runs as behavioral baseline evidence without treating them as proof of g6.xlarge timing.

Changed the current-quota GPU default to g6.xlarge and bound the live gate to GPU local_ready at or below 120 seconds, Runtime local_ready at or below 30 seconds, and controller service_ready at or below 270 seconds.
Reserved one final distinct g6.xlarge qualification under the aggregate USD 20 ceiling; no current-quota completion claim is made before that run passes.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove the current no-paid controller, Terraform, immutable activation, authorization, cleanup, residue, and current-quota threshold contracts.
Retain the first earlier larger-shape behavioral qualification as historical baseline evidence, not current g6.xlarge timing proof.
Retain the second earlier larger-shape behavioral qualification as historical repeatability evidence, not current g6.xlarge timing proof.
